label: training-gym-r27-complete
context:
Training Gym R22-R27 completed. 24/24 exercises pass with real pytest verification.

R27 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. trie-001 (T5) - Trie with autocomplete, frequency ranking, delete. 11 tests.
2. lru-001 (T5) - LRU cache with TTL, stats, thread-safe OrderedDict. 12 tests.
3. heap-001 (T5) - Min/max heap with heapify, sort, update, custom comparator. 14 tests. Fixed: test assumed heap index mapping after heapify.
4. graph-002 (T5) - Weighted graph + Dijkstra with shortest_path reconstruction. 11 tests.

KEY BUG FIXES:
- heap-001: Test used wrong index after heapify - heapify reorders elements so indices don't match original positions. Fixed by using push() for predictable structure.
- command-001 (R26): AddTextCommand computed position at init time - fixed to compute at execute time.

DB: 184 exercises, 347 attempts, avg 9.8
decisions: LRU cache: OrderedDict.move_to_end() is the canonical Python pattern
Trie autocomplete: sort by (-frequency, word) for deterministic ranking
Dijkstra: use prev dict for path reconstruction, not just distances
next_steps: Design R28 exercises. Consider: functional programming (curry, compose, memoize), or concurrency patterns (actor, CSP).
